name: read_page
description: Read the visible text of a browser tab the user is logged into. Returns { url, title, text }. Read-only; requires read consent for the tab's origin.

tabId.description: Optional tab id. Defaults to the active tab of the last focused window.

name: snapshot
description: Accessibility snapshot of a tab: interactive elements as { ref, role, name, value } (semantic, not CSS selectors). Read-only. Use the refs with find/extract.

tabId.description: Optional tab id. Defaults to the active tab of the last focused window.

name: find
description: Find elements on a tab by semantic query. Returns matching { ref, role, name }. Set query.expectUnique to require exactly one (else selector_not_found / ambiguous_target). Read-only.

tabId.description: Optional tab id. Defaults to the active tab of the last focused window.

name: extract
description: Read the text of a previously found element by ref (from snapshot/find). Returns { ref, role, name, text }. Read-only.

tabId.description: Optional tab id. Defaults to the active tab of the last focused window.

ref.description: a ref from a prior snapshot/find on this tab

snapshotId.description: optional; guards against a stale snapshot

name: click
description: Click a previously found element by ref (from find/snapshot). STATE-CHANGING — gated for approval and requires write consent for the tab's origin. Pass expectRole/expectName from the find result: the click only fires if the ref still resolves to a live element whose role and name match (TOCTOU guard), else it fails loud. Returns { ref, role, name, clicked }.

tabId.description: Optional tab id. Defaults to the active tab of the last focused window.

ref.description: a ref from a prior find/snapshot on this tab

expectName.description: the element's accessible name from find (e.g. "Submit"); verified against the live element before clicking

expectRole.description: the element's role from find (e.g. "button"); verified against the live element before clicking

snapshotId.description: optional; guards against a stale snapshot

name: fill
description: Set the value of a previously found editable field by ref (from find/snapshot). STATE-CHANGING — gated for approval and requires write consent for the tab's origin. Pass expectRole/expectName from the find result (TOCTOU guard: fails loud if the ref drifted). The value is entered as-is; secret values (e.g. into a password field) are redacted in the approval prompt and action log but still filled. Returns { ref, role, name, filled }.

tabId.description: Optional tab id. Defaults to the active tab of the last focused window.

ref.description: a ref from a prior find/snapshot on this tab

value.description: the text to set as the field value

expectName.description: the field's accessible name from find; verified before filling

expectRole.description: the field's role from find (e.g. textbox); verified before filling

snapshotId.description: optional; guards against a stale snapshot

name: navigate
description: Navigate a browser tab to a URL. STATE-CHANGING — gated for approval and requires write consent for the tab's current origin. The destination must be an origin you have already granted (else fails loud); the full URL including query string is shown in the approval prompt. Returns { url, navigated }.

tabId.description: Optional tab id. Defaults to the active tab of the last focused window.

url.description: the absolute URL to navigate the tab to (must be a granted origin)
